name_reason: Follows convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (animation domain, ani_decoder_src_buf descriptor) and reflects the data type (a 32-bit buffer-base/linear-address global). The src_buf suffix is NOT a Ghidra address residual (0x52766 != src_buf); it is a descriptor inherited consistently from the writer fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer's third parameter name src_buf. Semantic nuance: all four palette readers use this address as the palette WRITE/destination base (EDI in REP STOSD/MOVSD), so 'src' is from the setter's caller-side naming, not the readers' role; the name is internally consistent (setter param src_buf -> global src_buf) and both the src comment and Ghidra plate already document this nuance, so kept as-is to avoid diverging from original intent (renaming would also force renaming the setter param). Recorded as a name observation, not a rename.
purpose: ANI frame decoder palette-area base: 32-bit linear address used as the write/destination base by the four ANI palette chunk handlers (fill/literal/RLE/run-pairs); third of three adjacent per-frame decoder-state globals set by the target-buffer setter.
logic_summary: Plain mutable global at 0x52766, the third of three adjacent decoder-state slots (target_width @0x52760 ushort, dst_buf @0x52762 uint, src_buf @0x52766 uint), immediately followed by the function-pointer dispatch table data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_frame_dispatch_table @0x5276A. Written once per frame by fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer @0x36C95 (single 32-bit store of its src_buf param). Read by the four palette chunk handlers which cast it to a byte/dword pointer and write 768 bytes (256 RGB palette entries) at that base: fill_byte @0x36AE7 (REP STOSD broadcast one byte over 768), load_literal @0x36B01 (REP MOVSD copy 768 literal bytes from stream), load_rle @0x36B0F (RLE decode 768 bytes, C0-FF = run header), load_run_pairs @0x36B51 (segment list of (start,count), writes at base + start*3). Zero-initialized in the binary, filled at runtime by the setter before the decoder runs.
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar: a flat (linear) memory address that serves as the base pointer of the 768-byte (256-entry x 3-byte RGB) palette buffer written by the ANI palette chunk handlers.
notes: src comment (anidec.c lines 35-42) and Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT @0x52766 are both accurate, precise, and mutually consistent with the verified xrefs (1 WRITE from fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer @0x36C95; 4 READs from the palette chunk handlers @0x36AE7/0x36B01/0x36B18/0x36B52). Both already document the name nuance that the setter calls the param src_buf while the palette handlers use it as the output base. No edit needed to either; no logic touched. is_const=false confirmed by the single WRITE xref (runtime-filled BSS, correctly emitted as plain uint32). Verdicts: name=keep, comment=keep, plate=none.
